zh: NTSB尋獲Learjet 60駕駛艙語音記錄器
en: NTSB recovers Learjet 60 cockpit voice recorder.

zh: 法國航空A350與美國航空A321據報起飛後近乎空中相撞
en: Air France A350 and American Airlines A321 reportedly involved in a near-mid-air collision after departure.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：法國IRIS軍用觀測衛星將在軌飛行接替CSO，空中巴士主導逾15億歐元計畫；波音民航部門裁員約2500人，737MAX與787增產放緩
en: Aviation briefs: Airbus to Deliver IRIS, France's Next-Generation Military Earth Observation Satellites; Boeing to Cut About 2,500 Commercial Airplanes Jobs as Production Ramp-Up Slows

zh: 臺灣棒球隊搭星宇航空JX800赴日，AIRSORAYAMA GOLD藝術機執飛。
en: Taiwan's baseball team flew to Japan on STARLUX JX800 aboard an AIRSORAYAMA GOLD aircraft.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：波音將裁減商用飛機部門約5%職位 產量爬升慢於預期；菲律賓航空首開馬尼拉—芝加哥直飛：西向回程近17小時，每週3班A350執飛
en: Aviation briefs: Boeing to Cut About 5% of Commercial Airplane Workforce as Output Slows; Philippine Airlines launches first nonstop Manila–Chicago service: near-17-hour westbound leg, three weekly A350 flights

zh: NTSB公佈Learjet 60墜機殘骸回收進度
航空短訊彙整：美國對法國航空與荷蘭皇家航空開罰，涉達美航空共掛班號航班在伊拉克上空低於3.2萬英尺；英國航空波音787機身遭地勤車輛撞穿 滯留匹茲堡逾70天修復
en: Aviation briefs: US fines Air France and KLM for Delta Air Lines codeshare flights below 32,000 feet above Iraq; British Airways Boeing 787 Grounded in Pittsburgh for 2 Months After Vehicle Damage

zh: 華航前3季營收與淨利創同期新高
en: China Airlines reports record first-three-quarter revenue and net profit.

zh: Aer Lingus客機遭炸彈威脅改降，機上人員移至安全處
en: Aer Lingus A320 diverted after a bomb threat; passengers and crew moved to safety.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：杜勒斯機場逾200億美元改造計畫，聯合航空樞紐航廈將汰換；西南航空組員機上爭執致班機延誤逾兩小時，一人傳已辭職
en: Aviation briefs: Dulles airport unveils $20 billion transformation plan around United hub; Southwest crew dispute delays flight over two hours; attendant reportedly quits
